question.prompt: The mean, median, and mode of the \(7\) data values \(60,\) \(100,\) \(x,\) \(40,\) \(50,\) \(200,\) \(90\) are all equal to \(x.\) What is the value of \(x?\)

solutions.explanation:
The mean condition gives an equation immediately. The six fixed values sum to \(540\), so the mean of all seven values is \(\frac{540+x}{7}\). Thus
\[
\frac{540+x}{7}=x,
\qquad 540+x=7x,
\qquad x=90.
\]
We must also check the other two conditions. With \(x=90\), the ordered data are
\[
40,\ 50,\ 60,\ 90,\ 90,\ 100,\ 200.
\]
The fourth value is \(90\), so the median is \(90\). Also, \(90\) occurs twice and every other value occurs once, so the mode is \(90\). This candidate satisfies all three conditions, and the mean equation allows no other value. Therefore \(x=90\), choice \(\mathrm{D}\).
solutions.title: Use the mean, then check the median and mode
